Noelle (Marketing): quick sync: we need final X + LinkedIn schedule for June 7 product launch webinar. Deliverables: 2 hero images, 2 short clips (10s), 3 quote cards, seedlist, and monitoring rota. Who can take monitoring first 24h?
Kai (Social): I can cover US hours. Proposed times: X at 09:00 PT, LinkedIn at 09:30 PT, thread on X 4h later. Want to A/B CTA on X (Register vs Watch Demo).
Rhea (Content): Drafted short hooks: A: "Cut inference cost without losing quality — join Jun 7." B: "See our benchmark: same quality, lower token spend." Which for paid?
Ben (Growth): Paid pushes B. Organic can run A. I'll approve $2.5k initial seed if Ops-Bot confirms tracking work.
Iris (Design): Assets ETA tomorrow morning. Ill deliver hero-wide.png, hero-square.png, clip1.mp4, clip2.mp4, q1.png,q2.png,q3.png. Will include alt text drafts.
Ops-Bot: Confirmed: will create tag webinar-jun7 in HubSpot and route to SDR rotation. Will post webhook alerts to #inbound on paid-register clicks.
Noelle (Marketing): Good. Kai, schedule A/B on X (A=Register, B=Watch Demo). Rhea, please provide two alt-copy versions for LinkedIn with dual CTAs.
Kai (Social): Scheduling CSV I'll upload to the shared drive. Sample row: 2026-06-07T09:00:00-07:00,X,"Variant A short","hero-wide.png","?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jun7&utm_content=variantA"
Rhea (Content): LinkedIn drafts: "Live demo + tips: register (or choose 'Watch Demo' for a calendar slot)." and a longer human story lead. Dropping both in the doc.
Ben (Growth): Seedlist: prioritize ML infra companies and previous webinar attendees. I'll share sanitized CSV by 09:30 PT tomorrow.
Iris (Design): Small ask: leave safe area on left for headline overlay. I'll follow the campaign grid.
Noelle (Marketing): Monitoring: Kai first 12h; Ben to pick up night window if spikes. Ops-Bot will create tasks for any >3 signups/hr from paid.
Ops-Bot: Task rule created: if paid signups >3 per hour, create alert in #inbound and assign to on-call SDR.
Noelle (Marketing): Final checklist: captions locked by EOD today, assets in drive by 11am tomorrow, seedlist to Ben by 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
